note: Fixes an inherited kernel fault: a stage pinned to a measured mass flew with the inertia of the parts underneath rather than of the mass you pinned - roll low by exactly the pin factor, pitch able to go the other way. Only designs carrying a covering mass override move (every RASAero import does); everything else is bit-identical. Drift is where it shows: +0.2% at a 1.35x pin, +5.2% at 5x. Roll and pitch inertia are now on screen. Camera shrouds gain separate fore and aft end shapes and a conformal underside cut to the body tube, snap-to-fin buttons, and a warning when anything shares a rail button's line.
